newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Perdigao Q1 net profit jumps 196.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Perdigao Q1 net profit jumps 196.8 pct.

text.p: Perdigao, which owns Perdigao Alimentos, Perdigao
NOTE: All figures are in Brazilian reais and adjusted for inflation.
In a statement, the company said net rose 196.8 percent and sales climbed 27.6 percent compared with the same period last year.
The results, it added, reflect a 39.9 percent hike in production capacity of frozen pork and fowl to 115,917 tonnes, while prices rose at a rate below inflation.

The improved financial results in the first quarter were the result of launching of new products as well as a hike in its market share to 24.3 percent from 15.1 percent for frozen foods and 19.4 percent from 18.4 percent for industrial products, it said.
The statement said exports in the three-month period reached 88.3 million reais, up 72.1 percent from export revenues posted in the same period last year.
Perdigao preferred shares posted a profitability of 8.5 percent on volume of 7.9 billion shares and 90,100 American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
